review_candidates.title: Software Engineer II - CTJ - Poly
review_candidates.description: Overview Commercial Engineering & AI (CEAI) partners with stakeholders to transform Microsoft support through AI-native engineering, modern platforms, and intelligent customer experiences. Our teams design, build, and operate secure, reliable, and scalable services that help customers find information, resolve issues, and connect with the right support. Support Experience Group (SxG) is the engineering organization within Commercial Engineering & AI (CEAI) that builds and operates the platforms powering Microsoft's Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) support mission, including Dynamics for Microsoft (DfM) case management, CaseBuddy, Engage Center, the SxG ICon support portals, and AI-agent services. SxG delivers these across commercial and sovereign/government cloud boundaries including public/commercial Azure, and several specialized cloud environments, which includes a compliance-sensitive, multi-cloud footprint that drives a persistent need for cleared, high-side-capable engineers. You will join a small team of cleared high-side engineers supporting SxG's expanding scope and rising demand on the government and air-gapped cloud environments SxG supports. This team delivers the cloud parity charter, bringing Microsoft's commercial-grade customer-support capabilities (DfM case management, CaseBuddy, Engage Center, and AI-agent services) to government and sovereign customers whose environments are disconnected from the commercial cloud and governed by federal compliance and accreditation requirements. The work is distinct from commercial engineering: every capability we ship must be adapted to operate without direct internet connectivity, validated against the security controls of each cloud, and deployed through constrained, audited release pipelines. You will work across the full stack and the full delivery lifecycle, and your decisions directly affect whether high-side customers get parity with the commercial support experience. Responsibilities Design, document, implement, test, and deploy resilient, scalable services, individually and alongside the other high-side engineers on the team. Design, build, and operate secure, 24x7 SaaS services that integrate Dynamics 365, Azure Communication Services, and Azure AI services. Partner with Program Managers to understand business requirements and translate them into technical designs the team can execute. Collaborate with other software engineers in a diverse and inclusive environment. Port and adapt commercial services to run in disconnected government and air-gapped environments, resolving connectivity, dependency, and data-boundary constraints to close capability gaps against the parity charter. Own features end-to-end, from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and live-site health, across multiple cloud environments. Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code and safe-deployment pipelines using EV2 and Bicep to release reliably into commercial, government, and air-gapped clouds. Integrate AI-driven automation and agents into support workflows and operate them under government compliance constraints. Diagnose and resolve live-site incidents, and improve the monitoring, reliability, and security posture of services in accredited environments. Partner with security, compliance, and accreditation stakeholders to meet the controls required for each cloud. Qualifications Required Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 2+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience. Other Requirements Security Clearance Requirements: Candidates must be able to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: The successful candidate must have an active U.S. Government Top Secret Clearance with access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) based on a Single Scope Background Investigation (SSBI) with Polygraph. Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required pre-offer and post-hire for this role. Failure to maintain or obtain the appropriate U.S. Government clearance and/or customer screening requirements may result in employment action up to and including termination. Clearance Verification: This position requires successful verification of the stated security clearance to meet federal government customer requirements. You will be asked to provide clearance verification information prior to an offer of employment. Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. Citizenship & Citizenship Verification: This position requires verification of U.S. citizenship due to citizenship-based legal restrictions. Specifically, this position supports United States federal, state, and/or local United States government agency customer and is subject to certain citizenship-based restrictions where required or permitted by applicable law. To meet this legal requirement, citizenship will be verified via a valid passport, or other approved documents, or verified US government Clearance Preferred Qualifications Master's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 3+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 5+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience. A technical background in software engineering principles and architecture design. Experience with object-oriented programming languages and UI frameworks, such as C# and JavaScript/TypeScript. Experience with relational and/or No-SQL databases. Experience with web technologies such as React and/or Fluent UI. Experience building and operating services on cloud platforms such as Azure, including Application Insights, Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Azure Blob, Azure SQL, Azure Search, and Web Apps. Infrastructure-as-code and safe deployment with EV2 and Bicep. Sovereign or government cloud engineering. Building or integrating AI agents and copilots into production workflows. Experience working within regulated environments and formal compliance or accreditation processes. Software Engineering IC3 - The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $102,100 - $202,200 per year. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations, within the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, and the base pay range for this role in those locations is USD $133,800 - $219,200 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. Find additional benefits and pay information here: https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/us-corporate-pay This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about requesting accommodations.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer Projects Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description Stitch® is transforming customer engagement through AI-driven solutions tailored to each business’s needs. The platform connects customer service, marketing, and sales touchpoints into a unified, streamlined experience. By combining advanced AI technology with deep industry expertise, Stitch® helps organizations deliver smarter and faster interactions. The company focuses on personalization at scale, enabling businesses to create consistent, high-quality customer journeys. Team members work with cutting-edge tools in an environment that values innovation and impact. Role Description The Senior Software Engineer Project Lead is a full-time, on-site role based in Heliopolis. This role is responsible for leading the design, development, and deployment of backend services and core platform features that power Stitch®’s AI-driven customer engagement solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include architecting scalable systems, writing clean and maintainable code, reviewing the work of other engineers, and ensuring software quality through testing and best practices. The Project Lead will coordinate with product managers, data scientists, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions, while managing project timelines and deliverables. This role also involves mentoring junior engineers, improving development processes, and contributing to strategic technical decisions. Qualifications Strong foundation in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and system design. Proficiency in Software Development and Back-End Web Development, with experience building scalable and secure services. Advanced Programming skills and hands-on experience with Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and patterns. Proven experience leading engineering projects, including planning, execution, and delivery in a collaborative environment. Familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, relational and/or NoSQL databases, and modern development tools. Experience working with or integrating AI/ML-driven products is a plus. Ability to write clear technical documentation and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Analyzes user requirements and contributes to technical solutions with minimal supervision. Essential Functions Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end web applications using ReactJS, Java, and Spring Boot. Build reusable components, services, and libraries to support scalable application development. Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services consumed by web and mobile applications. Design, optimize, and maintain database solutions using SQL and PostgreSQL. Collaborate with Product, UX, Mobile, and Engineering teams to define, design, and deliver new features. Strong understanding of backend architecture, software design principles, testing, debugging, and performance optimization. Experience working in Agile development environments. Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Python or Scala. Exposure to Snowflake or modern data engineering platforms. Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, or containerized application development. Experience with Azure, AWS, or other cloud platforms. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. Experience implementing authentication and authorization solutions using OAuth, JWT, SSO, or similar technologies. Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

review_candidates.description: We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer, Backend to join Procore's Mobile engineering team. In this role, you'll be the connective tissue between our mobile clients and Procore's backend engineering teams, driving mobile-friendly API design and implementation that supports our offline-first architecture. Your primary goal is to make sure the APIs powering Project Management and Quality and Safety mobile experiences work the way mobile not just web needs them to, while mentoring engineers across a globally distributed team. As a Staff Software Engineer, Backend , you'll partner closely with backend teams across Procore as well as mobile client engineering, platform, and Product to represent mobile's needs early in API design conversations, and to help those teams build contracts that hold up in offline, low-connectivity, field conditions. Use your deep sympathy for client-side constraints, together with enough backend fluency to speak the language and influence the design, to close the gap that usually shows up only after mobile starts integrating. Join us to be the person who makes sure mobile and backend actually build for each other, on a team building the software that keeps construction projects — and the people managing them safe and on schedule. Apply today! This position reports into the Director of Engineering and will be based in our Cairo, Egypt office . We're looking for someone to join us immediately. Act as the primary liaison between Mobile Project Management and Quality and Safety and backend engineering teams, representing mobile's needs in API and contract design Drive mobile-friendly implementation of REST and GraphQL APIs with a focus on supporting our offline-first architecture, identifying where APIs won't hold up for low-connectivity or field-use conditions, and working with backend teams to close gaps Partner across a large number of collaborating teams backend, mobile clients, platform, and product to align on contracts, dependencies, and shared standards before they for how backend decisions land on client engineers — this matters more than owning backend services yourself Working fluency in backend development (Ruby on Rails, Node.js, Java, or similar) enough to engage credibly on designing or influencing REST and/or GraphQL APIs, ideally including offline-first or low-connectivity scenarios Exceptional communication skills and comfort collaborating across teams, translating ambiguous or competing needs into clear technical direction across time zones Strong Test Driven Development background and comfort with shift-left quality practices A systems thinker who enjoys the complexities of distributed systems, balanced with a pragmatic commitment to shipping working, high-quality code
